title: Eky'obugagga Ekyabbira Wansi w'Amalala
intro: Teebereza ng’oyimiridde mu maaso g’entuumu z’obugagga obunene ennyo ne kiba nti okusitula ebisumuluzo byokka kyandikooye ekibinja ky’abantu ssekinnoomu ab’amaanyi. Okukwetooloola, amaloboozi gakubiriza obwetoowaze n’okujjukira, naye amalala geeyongera okuwulikika okusinga okwebaza. Kiki ekibaawo ng’obugabi bufuuse ekigezo era amalala ne gassaako akabonero ku bivaamu?
clues: Nnali nva mu bantu ba Musa, naye ne mbasobya.
Nnaweebwa eby’obugagga ebinene ennyo ne kiba nti ebisumuluzo byabyo byandizitoowereddwa ekibinja ky’abasajja ab’amaanyi.
Nabuulirirwa abantu bange obutasanyuka n’okunoonya enkomerero nga tenneerabidde mugabo gwange ogw’ensi.
Nagamba nti bye nnalina byampeebwa olw’okumanya kwe nnalina kwokka.
Nagenda mu maaso g’abantu bange nga nnyirira, era abo abaali baagala obulamu obw’ensi ne baagala ebifaananako n’ebyo bye nnalina.
Ensi nnamira wamu n’ekifo we nnali mbeera, era tewali yali asobola kunnyamba wadde okweyamba.

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
